clue.text: Making it difficult to give up dress modelling

definitions.text: Making it difficult to give up

parts.note: a habit is a monk's or nun's dress
modelling clay is forming it into shape

explanation.surface: Someone finds a dress-modelling hobby impossible to quit.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit-forming substance or activity is addictive, so it makes stopping hard.

clue.text: Infantryman fired in expectation of success

indicators.note: one word sits inside the other

parts.note: hope is an expectation of success
lit means set alight, fired

explanation.surface: A foot soldier shoots, hoping to win.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoplite was a heavily armed foot soldier of ancient Greece.

clue.text: London borough is kind of 10

definitions.meaning: a small dark species of the birds in 10 across

explanation.definitionFit: The borough of north-west London shares its name with the brent goose.

clue.text: Examine catkin — it could be old or new

definitions.text: it could be old or new

parts.note: to test is to examine
ament is the botanical term for a catkin

explanation.surface: A botanist studies a catkin, unsure of its age.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible is divided into Old and New Testaments.

clue.text: Admits taking snow in powdered form

indicators.note: powdering breaks something into fine bits, so the letters of the word are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to taking cocaine.
explanation.walkthrough: Snow is slang for cocaine, which fits the confession surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up, or own, is to admit or acknowledge.

clue.text: Patron repairing a church manse

indicators.note: repairing puts something back together, so these letters are rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
taken as written

explanation.surface: A benefactor funds repairs to a church and its minister's house.
explanation.walkthrough: A manse is a minister's house.
explanation.definitionFit: Maecenas was the wealthy Roman sponsor of Virgil and Horace, so his name means a generous arts patron.

clue.text: Loose garment that is stripped off in the dark

indicators.note: something stripped off is removed, so these letters are taken away

parts.note: a nightie is a loose nightdress
ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone sheds a loose nightdress in a darkened room.
explanation.definitionFit: Night is the time of darkness.

clue.text: Disparage what pocket edition is designed to do?

parts.words: what pocket edition is designed to do?
parts.note: a pocket edition is meant to be small, read as the two words of the answer joined up

explanation.definitionFit: To belittle is to make something seem unimportant, to disparage it.

clue.text: Tenant without duplicate keys

parts.note: less means without, as in a pound less tax

indicators.note: a duplicate is a second copy, so the letter appears twice

parts.note: E is a musical key

explanation.surface: A tenant has no spare set of keys.
explanation.definitionFit: A lessee holds property under a lease, so is a tenant.

clue.text: Secluded part of garden can please when dug over

indicators.note: soil dug over is turned and broken up, so the letters of the two words are churned into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gardener promises that a quiet corner will charm once it has been dug.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasance is an old word for a secluded pleasure garden or part of one.

clue.text: Simpletons in a gaggle

definitions.meaning: a goose is a silly person, so simpletons are this plural
a gaggle is the collective noun for a flock of these birds on the ground

explanation.definitionFit: The birds gather in gaggles, and calling fools by the bird's name is an old insult.

clue.text: Where arrivals are held pending examination

definitions.text: Where arrivals are held pending examination

parts.words: Where arrivals are held pending examination
parts.note: sounds like an immigration hall, but the arrivals are incoming letters and papers on an office desk awaiting attention

explanation.definitionFit: An office desk tray holds incoming post until someone looks at it.

clue.text: Hippies, exhausted, hide in retreat

parts.note: beat is slang for worn out

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so the word for hide is read in reverse

parts.note: an animal's hide is its skin

explanation.surface: Worn-out hippies go into hiding, backing away from view.
explanation.definitionFit: Beatniks, the 1950s bohemians, are loosely equated with the later hippies as counterculture types.

clue.text: Steer clear of English source of Scream by Munch

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it starts, so its first letter is taken

parts.note: to munch is to chew

explanation.surface: A gallery visitor avoids Edvard Munch's famous painting The Scream.
explanation.definitionFit: To eschew something is to avoid or abstain from it deliberately.

clue.text: Pigeons run, carried by flat feet apparently

indicators.note: carried inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: flatfoot is slang for a policeman, so flat feet are coppers
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Pigeons are seemingly carried around on someone's flat feet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'apparently' is a link. Croppers are a breed of pigeon with a large crop.
explanation.definitionFit: Croppers, or pouters, are fancy pigeon breeds noted for inflating the crop.

clue.text: Spool of tape inserted in class

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the word for class

parts.note: a caste is a social class
a jewel set into a ring is inserted there

explanation.surface: A teacher slots a reel of tape into the lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: A cassette is a small case holding reels of magnetic tape.

clue.text: Cunning plot in which Marat gets undone

indicators.note: something undone is taken apart, so the letters are reassembled differently

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A conspiracy in which the French revolutionary Marat meets his end.
explanation.walkthrough: Marat was stabbed in his bath, so 'undone' suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A stratagem is a cunning scheme or trick.

clue.text: Spy given rise? It's importance may well be exaggerated

definitions.text: It's importance may well be exaggerated

parts.note: a mole is a spy inside an organisation
a hill is a rise in the land

explanation.surface: A promoted spy whose significance is overplayed.
explanation.walkthrough: Making a mountain out of a molehill means exaggerating a trivial thing.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom about making a mountain of it makes this the classic overblown trifle.

clue.text: Commercial selection for approval

parts.note: a commercial is an advert, an ad
an option is a choice or selection

explanation.surface: A selection of adverts is put forward to be signed off.
explanation.definitionFit: The adoption of a proposal is its formal acceptance or approval.

clue.text: Pineapple with nuts rejected at first

indicators.note: the first letter is thrown out

parts.note: bananas is slang for crazy, nuts

explanation.surface: A fruit dish of pineapple with nuts that were turned down at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Ananas is the French and botanical name for the pineapple.

clue.text: Vegetables' identified by little flags

definitions.meaning: leafy vegetables such as cabbage and kale are called this
on a golf course each putting surface is marked by a small flag on its pin

explanation.definitionFit: The word means leafy vegetables and also the putting surfaces of a golf course.

clue.text: Family member representing an old union

definitions.text: Family member representing an old union

parts.words: Family member representing an old union
parts.note: looks like a trade union delegate, but the union is a previous marriage of a parent, whose boy joins a new family

explanation.definitionFit: A son from a spouse's earlier marriage belongs to the new family by remarriage.

clue.text: Falsely accuses pompous person keeping a school

indicators.note: one word holds the other inside it, as a keeper holds something

parts.note: an ass is a foolish, self-important person
the Perse School is a well-known school in Cambridge

explanation.surface: A pompous man running a school brings false charges.
explanation.walkthrough: The Perse is an English independent school in Cambridge; ASS holds it between its two S's.
explanation.definitionFit: To asperse is to slander or cast damaging aspersions on someone.

clue.text: Revere, for example, a recommendation for mercy?

definitions.meaning: Paul Revere made a famous midnight ride in 1775
a jury may add a note recommending leniency to its verdict

explanation.definitionFit: A horseman like Revere, and an addendum such as a jury's plea for leniency.

clue.text: String may be kept in this firm

definitions.text: String may be kept in this
definitions.meaning: a string is a group of racehorses, kept in a racing yard

explanation.definitionFit: A racing yard housing a string of horses, and an adjective for steady and secure.

clue.text: Battalion keeping up fighting strength

indicators.note: one piece holds the other inside

parts.note: BN is the military abbreviation for battalion

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: war is fighting

explanation.surface: A battalion keeps its fighting strength up.
explanation.definitionFit: Brawn is muscular physical strength.

clue.text: Circus band

definitions.meaning: the arena where circus acts perform

explanation.definitionFit: Both a circus arena and a circular band, such as on a finger.

clue.text: Expressed publicly by Guder- ian taking part in retreat

indicators.note: retreating goes backwards, so the letters are read right to left
only a part of the general's name supplies the letters

explanation.surface: Something is broadcast by the German tank general Guderian during a withdrawal.
explanation.walkthrough: Heinz Guderian was a German WWII tank commander; DERIA inside his name, reversed, gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Views aired are voiced or broadcast to the public.

clue.text: One shop, girl serving ingredient for jelly?

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
to shop someone is to inform on them, to sing
a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A lone shop girl serves an ingredient for a dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: Isinglass is a gelatin from fish bladders, used in jellies and for clarifying.

clue.text: Wage-earner given good warning about introduction to work

parts.note: prole, short for proletarian, is a working-class wage-earner
an omen is a warning sign
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A worker gets fair warning about starting a new job.
explanation.definitionFit: A prolegomenon is a preliminary discussion prefacing a book or treatise.
